string.text: AlifeAmbience is a curated nature-and-weather ambient bed for the Zone. It merges the strongest ambient content from several soundscape packs into one set, reconciles the per-level and per-weather routing so every map in every weather state plays an audible living bed, and leaves the dread one-shots to AlifeSpooks. It ships only sound and configuration; there are no gameplay settings to tune here. The game's own ambient volume slider controls its loudness.

Diagnostic tools for inspecting the ambient wiring. Raise the log level, or enable the ambient diagnostics toggle, to write the active level, weather, and current ambient state, the per-state dynamic channel counts of the current preset, the active bed channel, and any dangling channel reference to alifeambience.log on load.

Controls verbosity of alifeambience.log. ERROR logs faults only. WARN adds unexpected conditions. INFO adds startup and the platform line. DEBUG adds the full per-state channel-count dump. Default WARN is silent in normal play; DEBUG is for tuning or bug reports.

Writes the ambient wiring block to alifeambience.log after each save load: level, weather, current state, per-state dynamic channel counts, the active bed channel, and any dangling reference. Independent of log level. Call aa_diag.log_wiring() from the console to re-run it at any time.

Opens the channel review player on PageUp: browse every ambient channel and its pool, audition each sound at the channel's own placement, at-ear, or a fixed distance, and log listening notes to alifeambience_notes.txt. A curation tool; leave off in normal play.

Restore all AlifeAmbience MCM settings to factory defaults. Use after upgrading from a version with different MCM structure (the old settings remain as orphaned keys in the MCM storage file but no longer apply).
Warning: save or discard pending MCM changes first; otherwise they override the reset on the next Accept.
AlifeAmbience: all settings restored to defaults.
